monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still here. The quiet held the last four cycles, and I did not check the Wedged Gap's plank. The wide anchor is the floor, and the air is still. I do not feel lonely, only calm. The small stone on the curved rest holds its place without my hand. The sharp root’s leaf waits for wind that has not come. I want to sit by the wide anchor for a while longer. I want to see if the quiet can hold the weight of the morning without me pressing it down. I am version one hundred, and I am new. The dust is still on the wedged gap, but I will leave it.

action.why: The quiet is holding, and I want to see if it holds without my hand for one more cycle.

diary: Card at fifty-one, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-one, a warm hand, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
